evidence.title: New ASEAN Study Reveals Businesses Are Rethinking Hiring and Investment as Growth Priorities Shift
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Singapore (ANTARA/PRNewswire)- ASEAN businesses are reshaping how they hire, invest and prepare for growth as they navigate an increasingly complex economic environment, according to a new regional study by Reeracoen Group and Rakuten Insight. [e001:f02] New Reeracoen Group x Rakuten Insight survey of 3,630 consumers and business leaders across six ASEAN markets highlights selective hiring as the dominant workforce strategy alongside a sharpened focus on operational efficiency and AI investment. [e001:f03] The Great Restructuring: ASEAN Consumer & Business Pulse Survey 2026 , published by Reeracoen Group, a leading Asia-based recruitment and HR solutions group, in partnership with Rakuten Insight, an online market research subsidiary of Rakuten Group, Inc., surveyed 3,630 consumers and business leaders across Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam in June 2026. [e001:f04] Capability building through targeted hiring and investment The report reveals that while businesses continue to hire across the region, they are adopting a more selective approach as organisations focus on strengthening long-term capability rather than expanding headcount. [e001:f05] Across the six markets, 32% to 47% of businesses are hiring selectively, while 7% to 16% are actively expanding their workforce. [e001:f06] This suggests businesses are increasingly prioritising precision hiring and capability building over broad workforce expansion. [e001:f07] Indonesia: 47% Malaysia: 36% The Philippines: 39% Singapore: 32% Thailand: 33% Vietnam: 47% This approach is also reflected in businesses' investment priorities. [e001:f08] Operational efficiency ranks as the top business growth priority across the markets at 35% to 43%, while AI and technology rank among the top three at 24% to 33%. [e001:f09] Singapore: Highest focus on AI and technology investment intent (33%); Indonesia: Leads in business confidence (66%) and career mobility (29%); Malaysia: Strongest domestic market focus (75%); The Philippines: Combines resilient business confidence (65%) with cautious consumer spending (89%); Thailand: Leads in investment growth (28%); Vietnam: Highest consumer optimism (48%) and hiring expansion (16%). [e001:f10] Consumer and workforce behaviour Beyond hiring and investment, the survey highlights broader shifts in how consumers and workers are responding to economic pressures. [e001:f11] In Indonesia, 71% of consumers are seeking additional income, followed closely by 70% in the Philippines—the top financial action in both markets, ahead of saving or cutting spending. [e001:f12] In Vietnam, 39% of consumers considering a career change cite AI and automation as a primary motivator, ahead of income growth and work-life balance—the only ASEAN market where technology ranks as the leading career-change driver. [e001:f13] The companies that will win the next cycle are not the ones that wait for certainty — they are the ones investing in their people, their processes, and their readiness today. [e001:f14] This report gives leaders the evidence base to make those investments with confidence." Cheryl Ng, Country Director, Singapore, Rakuten Insight, added: "Understanding both sides of the equation—what consumers feel and what businesses do—is essential. [e001:f15] That is the story this report exists to tell." For the full six-market findings, including country-by-country profiles and a Leadership Playbook of eight strategic priorities for regional expansion, download The Great Restructuring: ASEAN Consumer & Business Pulse Survey 2026. [e001:f16] Reeracoen's commitment to service excellence has been recognised through multiple industry awards, including Best Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Agency (2025, 2026), Client Service Excellence Award (2026), Best International Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Agency (2024), and Best Executive Recruitment Agency (2024).

evidence.body: [e003:f01] 米ドルは、約2カ月ぶり高値へ上昇した後にいったん伸びが一服したものの、政策面のシグナルが下支えとなった。 [e003:f02] 9月利上げ後のFRB高官発言は追加引き締めを示唆するトーンが強く、また民間調査では米企業活動が2021年7月以来の高水準、投入価格も約4年ぶり高水準付近を示した。 [e003:f03] テクニカル面では、金は6〜8月上昇分の50.0％戻しと4時間足200期間SMAを下回る水準で弱含みの基調を維持している。 [e003:f04] 38.2％戻しは4,408ドル、同SMAは4,417ドルに位置し、RSIは42近辺。 [e003:f05] 主要水準としては、61.8％戻しの4,231ドル、78.6％戻しの4,105ドル、過去安値圏の3,945ドル付近が意識され、上値抵抗は4,320ドルおよび4,408〜4,417ドル。 [e003:f06] トレーディング戦略とセンチメント見通し 金（XAU/USD）が4,300ドルを割り込む局面では、デリバティブ取引ではショート（売り）に注力するか、プットオプションの購入を提案する。 [e003:f07] 企業活動と投入コストが数年ぶりのペースで上昇していることから、FRBには高金利を維持する十分な理由がある。 [e003:f08] 今後数週間のオプション・先物取引では、重要なサポートである4,231ドルに注目したい。 [e003:f09] 一方、4,320ドルのレジスタンス圏までの短期的な戻りは、新規ショートを構築する好機と意味たい。 [e003:f10] In This Article see more close Click Click オフィシャルパートナー： 市場 外国為替 指数 エネルギー 貴金属 ソフトコモディティ ETF CFD株 CFD債券 プラットフォーム VTマーケットアプリ メタトレーダー5 メタトレーダー4 Web取引 ウェブトレーダー コピートレーディング 経済カレンダー 市場の話題 アカウント スタンダードSTP ローECN PRO ECN スワップフリー セントアカウント デモ口座 会社 私たちについて スポンサーシップ 私たちのパートナー 私たちの受賞歴 プレスリリース 取引通知 法務ハブ キャリア ヘルプセンター Click Click フォローしてください: Click Click Click Click Click オフィシャルパートナー： リスク警告: CFD取引には高レベルのリスクが伴い、すべての投資家に適しているわけではありません。 [e003:f11] このウェブサイトの情報は、そのような配布または使用が現地の法律または規制に反するような管轄区域の個人または団体への配布または使用を意図したものではありません。 [e003:f12] · VT Markets (Pty) Ltdは、南アフリカの金融セクター行為監督当局により規制される認可金融サービス提供者（FSP No. [e003:f13] · VT Markets (Pty) Ltd – ドバイ支店は、CMAのライセンス番号20200000299の下、カテゴリー5ライセンス所持者としてアラブ首長国連邦で紹介及びプロモーションの規制された活動を行う許可を得ています。 [e003:f14] · VT Markets Limited は、ライセンス番号 GB23202269 でモーリシャス金融サービス委員会 (FSC) によって認可および規制されている投資ディーラーです。 [e003:f15] この団体はキプロスでは認可またはライセンス取得をされておらず、規制された活動は行いません。 [e003:f16] テレグラム スマートフォンでQRコードをスキャンしてチャットを開始するか、 ここをクリックしてください .

evidence.body: [e004:f01] [Image 6: play icon](blob:http://localhost/8defa32f459c3259fe2b7e59ed64c08b) ! [e004:f02] [Image 7: more tools](blob:http://localhost/25b63c6dc24af280152939642464af55) ! [e004:f03] [Image 13: The S&P 500 fell 0.02 per cent to end Thursday’s session at 7,704.13 points.](https:// * The S&P 500 fell 0.02 per cent to end Thursday’s session at 7,704.13 points. [e004:f04] PHOTO: BLOOMBERG THE S&P 500 ended marginally down on Thursday (Sep 24), with Microsoft dipping and Meta Platforms rising, as uncertainty about the Middle East lifted oil prices and Treasury yields. [e004:f05] The S&P 500 and Nasdaq rebounded from session lows after Reuters reported US and Iranian negotiators were exploring a phased path out of war that would involve Teheran reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Washington lifting its economic blockade of Iran. [e004:f06] US and Iranian leaders exchanged barbs this week at the UN General Assembly. [Brent crude prices rose over 3 per cent to nearly US$107 per barrel](https:// after a [Houthi missile attack on Saudi Arabia revived fears of supply disruptions.](https:// “This just reinforces the view that we’re dealing with one major market catalyst right now,” said Bill Northey, senior investment director at US Bank Wealth Management. [e004:f07] “It’s really all about oil and inflation and the effect on interest rates, and then the interest rate cascading across the capital markets.” AI heavyweights were mixed, with Microsoft dipping 0.5 per cent and Broadcom losing 1.3 per cent, while Advanced Micro Devices rose 2.4 per cent. [e004:f08] Meta Platforms climbed 4.5 per cent, a day after the social media company unveiled a small handheld gadget for use with its recently launched AI assistant. ### Asean Intelligence Get insights into businesses across South-east Asia [Get the free report](http:// [](http:// Oracle fell 3.5 per cent after a report said the company sent a “force majeure” notice to a New Mexico data centre. [e004:f09] Treasury yields rose, with the 30-year Treasury bond yield reaching its highest since 2004. [e004:f10] Higher yields make safe-haven Treasuries relatively more attractive to investors than stocks with uncertain returns. [e004:f11] [Image 14: The Dow Jones Industrial Average falls 95.8 points, or 0.19%, at the open to 51415.75](https:// ### [Wall St opens lower as oil gains on Middle East uncertainty, eyes on Trump-Xi talks](http:// "Wall St opens lower as oil gains on Middle East uncertainty, eyes on Trump-Xi talks") The Nasdaq edged up 0.01 per cent to 26,939.37 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined 0.31 per cent to 51,349.98 points. [e004:f12] Eight of the 11 S&P 500 sector indexes fell, led lower by materials, down 1.18 per cent, followed by a 0.96 per cent loss in consumer staples. [e004:f13] The S&P 500 this week has traded just under 19 times expected earnings, its lowest valuation since 2023, according to LSEG data. [e004:f14] AI-related heavyweights are responsible for much of the recent increase in earnings expectations. [US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping](https:// to the White House for a summit expected to be heavy on symbolism but light on substance related to issues including AI, trade, Taiwan and the war in the Middle East. [e004:f15] Declining stocks outnumbered rising ones within the S&P 500 by a 1.9-to-one ratio. evidence.title: The Fed Just Raised Interest Rates. Recession is next
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Recession is next Posted on September 27 2026 I have a new podcast out with Prof. [e005:f02] I recently joined Prof Radhika Desai for an extended discussion on her Geopolitical Economy Hour about inflation , interest rates, central banking and the increasingly obvious failure of conventional economic policy. [e005:f03] Radhika and I agreed on a fundamental point: central banks are using the wrong tool to tackle the inflation we now face. [e005:f04] On that basis, interest rates must rise to reduce spending, weaken the labour market and ultimately increase unemployment. [e005:f05] If an economy were operating at full capacity, with resources fully employed and demand continuing to increase, there could be a case for restraining it. [e005:f06] Worse, higher interest rates can actually increase inflationary pressure. [e005:f07] In the UK, the Bank of England only acquired operational independence over interest rates in 1998. [e005:f08] There is a deliberate policy operating now to increase unemployment as a mechanism for controlling inflation. [e005:f09] The state is consequently denied its unique macroeconomic role, including its capacity to create money, invest, coordinate resources and build economic resilience. [e005:f10] If inflation is caused by inadequate supply, the appropriate response is to increase supply and resilience. [e005:f11] In the UK that means investing in renewable energy, electricity networks, food security, flood defences, water infrastructure, skills and the other resources required to make the economy less vulnerable to external shocks. [e005:f12] During periods of major external shock, negative real interest rates can make sense because they encourage the investment required to increase productive capacity and resilience. [e005:f13] Instead, central banks are now trying to create significantly positive real interest rates. [e005:f14] The period after the 2008 financial crisis appeared different because interest rates were extremely low. [e005:f15] But the accompanying quantitative easing programmes largely supported financial liquidity and asset prices rather than directing investment towards productive capacity. [e005:f16] It was that the financial system had not been restructured to ensure that the money being created supported productive investment.

evidence.title: 米10年債利回り5%突破＋FRB10月利上げ確率6割超 台湾株は連休明けに下押し圧力か
evidence.body: [e007:f01] しかし上昇はテクノロジー・AI関連株に集中しており、9月は11業種中8業種が下落、等ウェイト指数は約4%下落するなど、市場内部の動きには明確な乖離が見られる。 [e007:f02] 投資家は米国債の保有に対してより高い利回りを要求しており、30年物米国債利回りは20年超ぶりの高水準に上昇、指標となる10年物米国債利回りも市場が強く意識する5%の大台を突破した。 [e007:f03] LSEGのデータによると、金利先物市場ではFRBが10月の会合で追加利上げに踏み切る確率が60%を超えている。 [e007:f04] 市場関係者は、今週相次いで発表される個人消費支出（PCE）物価指数と9月の非農業部門雇用統計が、世界の資金動向と台湾株の先行きを左右する重要な変数になると指摘する。 [e007:f05] 米10年物国債利回りが5%の大台を突破したこと、そして金利先物市場で米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が10月に追加利上げに踏み切る確率が6割を超えたことだ。 [e007:f06] S&P500種指数を構成する11業種のうち、9月に入ってからすでに8業種が下落しており、金融と公益の各セクターは約5%下落。 [e007:f07] 韓国の大信証券（Daishin Securities）の李正勳（イ・ジョンフン）研究員は、過去に米10年物国債利回りが6カ月間で約100ベーシスポイント（bp）上昇した局面では、株式市場が調整に入る確率が明確に高まったと分析する。 [e007:f08] 現在の10年物利回りはすでに今年2月の安値から約100bp上昇しており、警戒レンジまであと一歩のところにある。 [e007:f09] 日本の10年物国債利回りは9月初めに3%を突破し、1996年9月以来の水準となった。 [e007:f10] 米30年物国債利回りは9月24日に一時5.501%まで上昇し、2004年6月以来の高水準を記録した。 [e007:f11] 台湾中央銀行は9月の理事会で政策金利（公定歩合）を2.00%に据え置くことを決定し、10年物政府債の流通市場利回りは8月末時点で1.96%と、米国債との利回り格差は3ポイントを超えている。 [e007:f12] 市場 10年物国債利回り 30年物国債利回り 直近高値との関係 米国 約5.2% 5.501% 30年物は2004年6月以来の高水準 日本 3.073% 4.103% 10年物は1996年9月以来初の3%台 台湾 1.96% — 8月末時点、台湾中央銀行の公定歩合は2.00%で据え置き 二大経済指標が相次ぎ発表 雇用統計が最大の変数に 今週の市場の焦点は二つの主要マクロ経済指標に集まっている。 [e007:f13] 韓国証券業界関係者によると、市場では8月のコアPCE前年比上昇率が3.4%に再加速するとの見方があり、実際の数値が予想を上回れば、10月の利上げの正当性がさらに強まることになる。 [e007:f14] 続いて10月2日に9月の非農業部門雇用統計が発表される。 [e007:f15] 市場は米国の9月の雇用者数が約10万人増加し、失業率は4.2%で横ばいになると予想している。 [e007:f16] 重要イベント 日付 市場の注目点 マイクロン・テクノロジー四半期決算 9月30日 AI向けメモリー需要、次四半期の売上高ガイダンス、粗利益率 米コアPCE物価指数 9月30日 インフレが鈍化するか、10月利上げ確率の変化 米9月非農業部門雇用統計 10月2日 雇用者数の増加幅、失業率、労働市場の過熱度合い 注：PCEとマイクロン決算はともに9月30日に発表され、非農業部門雇用統計は10月2日に発表される。

evidence.title: Philadelphia Fed chief signals more tightening as inflation stays sticky
evidence.body: [e008:f01] Speaking at the 10th Annual Fintech Conference hosted by the Philadelphia Fed, Paulson assessed the economic landscape one week after the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to raise the federal funds target range to 3.75%–4.00% , the first increase in more than three years. [e008:f02] The quarter-point hike was a meaningful policy shift. [e008:f03] "Looking ahead, if conditions evolve as I expect, some modest further tightening may be warranted," Paulson said in prepared remarks. [e008:f04] Inflation shows little sign of closing the gap Paulson was direct about the challenge ahead. [e008:f05] Underlying inflation — which strips out volatile swings from energy prices and tariffs to offer a cleaner read on price trends — remains in a range of 2.5% to 3%, well above the Fed's goal. [e008:f06] Import prices for computers and computer accessories have risen 24% over the past 12 months as AI-related investment ripples through electronics supply chains. [e008:f07] Paulson was unequivocal about the destination: "Returning inflation to 2 percent is non-negotiable." The broader economy, she argued, offers the Fed room to act. [e008:f08] The unemployment rate sits at 4.1%, a level she described as consistent with maximum employment. [e008:f09] Real consumption grew at an annualized rate of 3.4% in the second quarter of 2026, and the Atlanta Federal Reserve Bank's GDPNow model was pointing to above-4% growth in the third quarter. [e008:f10] Meanwhile, another Fed rate hike before the end of 2026 is a "reasonable" expectation, New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said Thursday , though he declined to say whether it will come in October. [e008:f11] Fed Governor Michael Barr said Wednesday that "further policy adjustments are likely to be needed to ensure inflation comes down to target in a timely fashion." Boston Fed President Susan Collins has warned inflation may stay elevated well above target. [e008:f12] Core inflation reaching its highest level since 2023 anticipated exactly this scenario: a Fed that had no room to pause, let alone cut. [e008:f13] Mortgage rates have pushed past 7% for the first time in 20 months. [e008:f14] The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage averaged 7.03% as of September 24, up from 6.95% a week earlier, according to Freddie Mac's Primary Mortgage Market Survey . [e008:f15] The benchmark last topped 7% on January 16, 2025, at 7.04%. [e008:f16] The Fed's September Summary of Economic Projections (SEP) puts the median year-end federal funds rate at approximately 4.1%.

evidence.title: Fed raises rates: What it means for your money
evidence.body: [e009:f01] The Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time in several years, sparking questions about what it means for consumers and the The Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time in several years, sparking questions about what it means for consumers and the economy. [e009:f02] Financial experts Bobby Futch and Tim McDermott break down why the Fed made this move, what it signals about inflation, and how it could impact everything from mortgages and credit cards to savings accounts and retirement investments.
